name: Ground 2 Corners

weightBudget.basis: One 35 mm sandstone pavement tile, rounded cobbles and shallow joints; 1024/512 colour atlases, lower resolution normal/ORM and Meshopt geometry.

reviewNotes: PDF page 2. Two isolated sandstone corners surround the gravel floor; native 35×35 mm footprint, 10 mm insertion depth, maximum z=19.179 mm. Measure stone caps above 18.3 mm and keep the central gravel standable; separate warm earth from stone corners by the sculpt height. Warm sandstone palette from author PDF; albedo-only correction retains all accepted geometry and PBR data maps.
